scope: Current offline production Worker / DOM / software WebGL with whole geometry-only FlightHelmet. Not React or generic Three importer certification.

tests.name: Correct whole model generated with no source UV
Complete narrow part: full-length sides and end cap, not upper/lower diagonal fragments
Complete 14992-face closed shell becomes two verified skins
Full ribbon reaches its actual target UV
Shell inspector reports measured current UV reflection
tests.detail: 表面对称已验证，使用三角面内的重心对应，不要求左右顶点或三角形一一配对。 表面采样匹配 99.6%，边界/闭合折边匹配 95.1%；原顶点近精确配对（采样） 0.0%（仅诊断，不是门槛）。当前 UV 镜像均方根误差 0.105%，边界 0.112%，最大 0.504%（相对当前岛直径）。 不改变三维网格、不复制半片，也不使用原 UV。

tests.name: Playback speed and camera independence preserved
Repacking cannot change complete group membership
Fill executes on current result and preserves skin correspondence
